- Ask whether Redwood offers an early-remittance program (we typically evaluate ~1.0–2.0% discount for payment within 10 days) and enrollment steps.
- Confirm the PO intake and billing instructions Redwood needs (PO header fields, remit-to, tax form requirements) so we can align our procurement workflow and avoid rejects.

Appreciate your help — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that's easier.

Hi team,

Thanks for the ping — Ben from Finance here. Quick run-down from AP/Finance requirements and what we need to assess the Net30/early-pay ask: 

- Mandatory: Completed vendor onboarding form (we have it), W9 (U.S. vendors) or relevant tax docs, and certificate of insurance if total annual spend is > $50k.
- PO header: needs vendor legal name, remit address, PO number (alphanumeric ok), and an accounting code (we can accept your project code or map to our GL).
- For Net30 exceptions: we require a short business justification and approval from Sr. Finance (I handle approvals up to Net30 for new vendors; above that goes to controller).
- Early-pay program: we operate a dynamic discounting workflow via our payment provider (details below). Please confirm your banking remit instructions and whether the discount should apply per invoice or per monthly settlement.

Requested items from SolvoTec to put this through: 
1) W9 or foreign equivalent (tax docs)
2) Bank remit instructions (ACH details) — we need to register bank info with our payment provider before enabling discounts.
3) Confirmation whether invoices will be emailed to invoices@redwood.com or pushed to SFTP.
4) A 1–2 line business justification for Net30 (helps with audit trail).

If you can get the above by Wednesday EOD I’ll aim to sign off on Net30 and put the early-pay tier in pilot for the first two invoices. Ben

Attachment referenced: payment-provider-onboarding.pdf (we use PayQuick; procurement doc)
